A job directory the system ANSI code page (1252) cannot spell is refused (unrepresentable_path): fwg.exe takes narrow arguments. Jobs live in the per-user store under %LOCALAPPDATA%, so a Windows user name with letters outside that code page cannot generate a world.

Open: The module assembly embeds worldgen/templates/cultures/*.json, which carry about 1,051 name and lore strings with their localisation ids copied from the game's culture definitions (spcultures.xml), 7 of them culture lore paragraphs. They are not game files, but they are copied official text; whether to resolve them from the player's installation instead is an open decision (MMR-57).
